desc: Implement `BIT` class with `add`, `prefix_sum`, and `find_kth` (order statistic) for efficient updates and queries.
Coordinate‑compress the values in `nums` and build two BITs (one for frequencies, one for sums).
Compute the cost for every length‑`x` window using a sliding‑window median approach with the BITs, storing results in an array `cost`.
Perform dynamic programming with two rolling arrays to select `k` non‑overlapping windows with minimal total cost.
Return `dp_prev[n]` as the result and implement the `Solution.minOperations` method.
Test the solution on the provided examples and on random small cases to verify correctness and performance.
